versions.changelog:
Session Content Classification Assistant 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Supports multilingual (English & Chinese) session content classification.
- Auto-organizes conversations by topic or user-specified keywords.
- Outputs standardized Markdown documents with precise second-level timestamps.
- Ensures no modification to original content, with duplicate and irrelevant entries handled appropriately.
- Fixed, clear Markdown structure for all outputs.
